humanVisualMethod.readingContract: Every seat number and every row identifier in this table was read from printing on the chart. Within a contiguous printed run the numbering was verified sequential by counting cells between two printed endpoints. Where a run boundary carried a printed number on only one side, the opposite endpoint was obtained by counting cells inside that same contiguous run from its own printed anchor - never by extrapolating across a boundary, and never from a neighbouring row.
humanVisualMethod.keyStructuralFinding: Numbering discontinuities on this chart are NOT proportional to the drawn gap. Verified cases: rows A-H at the left flank run 341-335 then 333 across a sub-cell-width separator (334 absent); the 320|319 aisle is physically wide yet skips no number; and at the top-right level-200 block two physically adjacent cells carry 488 and 608. No endpoint was therefore ever inferred from spacing.

areaOwnership.issue: The raster prints no area or level name anywhere.
areaOwnership.resolution: Ownership was taken from the chart's own SVG layer, which declares four issuer level groups - lv_200, lv_300, lv_400, lv_500 - each containing the highlight regions covering that level's seating. This is issuer-declared structure inside the chart asset itself, corroborated by the chart's visible printed gate numbers, which fall in the matching 2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx families.
areaOwnership.identityModel: (level, rowLabel, seatNumber). Row labels are printed: letters A-L in the level-200 arena-adjacent tier, integers elsewhere. No repository-invented area name was created, and none is required for uniqueness.

regionLedger.note: Rows A-H, 8 rows. Band boundaries verified aligned across all rows at 14x; 341-335 cell-counted (7 cells); 320|319 re-read at 15x (no skip despite wide aisle); 335|333 re-read at 14x (334 absent, no physical gap).

Rows A-H, 8 rows; mirror of left flank. 722|724 break re-read at 14x and confirmed aligned across all 8 rows. Rows C-H lie under the semi-transparent エンドステージ1 overlay but are fully drawn; stage-position invariance of fixed seating already frozen upstream.

Rows A-L, 12 rows, horizontal. Two printed vertical aisles carry the row letters; 457|458 and 482|483 are numerically contiguous but physically separated, so kept as separate runs. 470 absent between 469 and 471. Row start/end digits re-read at 11x: 449, 454, 486, 491 are not used as row endpoints.

Rows A-L, 12 rows, horizontal; numbering decreases left-to-right. Two printed vertical aisles carry the row letters; 161|160 and 136|135 numerically contiguous but physically separated, kept as separate runs. 148 absent between 149 and 147. 164, 169, 132, 127 are not used as row endpoints.

Rows 1-19 horizontal. Left sub-block rectangular across all 19 rows: runs 483-488 and 608-617 (printed numbering discontinuity, no physical gap, re-read at 14x). Right sub-block starts at printed 618 (anchored at row 4 label and row 10 teal marker) with a diagonal right edge; per-row right endpoints are NOT printed except row 19 (621), so rows 4-18 right endpoints were obtained by direct cell counting at 8x within each contiguous run.

Rows 1-19 horizontal. Sub-block 442-457 (16 cells) uniform across all rows; sub-block 458-482 (25 cells) continuous for rows 1-16. Rows 17-18 carry a printed notch: 458-467 then 478-482. Row 19 has no cells in the 478-482 group - resolved at 26x, the area above the 478/482 labels is blank. 468-477 absent in rows 17,18,19 only.

Rows 1-3 (row 1 nearest arena). 12 printed blocks: 55-61,62-74,75-79,81-87,88-98,99-108,109-118,119-129,130-136,138-142,143-155,156-162. 80 and 137 absent. Each block's range printed at both row 3 and row 1; all three rows share the block range.

Rows 1-3. 12 printed blocks: 163-169,170-182,183-187,189-195,196-206,207-216,1-10,11-21,22-28,30-34,35-47,48-54. 29 and 188 absent. Together with the top band this closes a 1-216 ring with exactly four absent numbers (29,80,137,188).

3 rows (row 1 nearest arena). 10 printed blocks spanning 182-251 and 343-432; the 252-342 gap is a physically empty top-centre section. End blocks 182-184 and 410-432 read at the block junctions. All ranges printed at both ends of each row; deskewed rendering used to count cells.

3 rows. 10 printed blocks spanning 92-181 and 433-502, numbering decreasing left-to-right in each half. Block junctions re-read at 4.2x deskew to fix the 159/161/164 endpoints. The 92|502 junction is a single printed aisle across which the numbering is discontinuous - recorded as printed, not interpolated.
